insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Taliyah is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Taliyah in 43/102 games (42%): 20 picks (9-11) and 23 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Rumble? They go K'Sante
insights.text: Rumble is a G1 favorite (18/38 G1s, played by Clear). In the 40 later games where it was burned or banned, Clear went to K'Sante (7/40) and Renekton (7/40).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they stay closer to their core than most
insights.text: In 26 G3+ games, 25/130 picks (19%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 52 champs in G1s, 63 in G3+.
